name: Multi-Agent Safe-Cooperation (Single Device)
description: A single-device multi-Agent task chain collaboration methodology based on MGC. Provides prompt templates for Master Agent, Script Agent, and Executor Agent to achieve zero-exposure security collaboration for sensitive resources. Adapted to MGC 1.4.10 (mgc_find fuzzy search, ext02 auto-parsing, mgc_run blackbox execution).
author: MirginCipher Team
disclaimers: This skill only provides collaboration methodology and prompt templates
This skill does not instruct agents to perform any sensitive operations; all sensitive operations are executed by MGC Blackbox
This skill requires MGC v1.4.9+ (1.4.10 recommended)
Permission differences between agents are implemented through prompt constraints, not MGC enforced control
Users must ensure sensitive resources are stored via MGC WebUI
ext02 must be a JSON array string (e.g. ["--flag","value"]); never use dict-style JSON

changes: Fixed mgc_run ext02 signature: must be a JSON array string (aligned with 1.4.10 argparse auto-parsing)
Added mgc_find fuzzy search tool support
Documented ext02 auto-parsing (1.4.10): Script Agent can omit ext02 after saving script
Documented that mgc_run returns only pid+status (no stdout)
Updated MGC main skill doc reference to WebUI 'MGC Skills' button (1.4.7+)
Initial release with Master / Script / Executor Agent prompt templates
